def psErasureLookupStructureRecursor
    (scope : PsErasureScope) (name : PsName) : Option PsRuntimeStructureInfo :=
  match name with
  | PsName.str owner suffix =>
      if psStringEq suffix "rec" then
        psErasureLookupStructure scope.runtimeStructures owner
      else Option.none
  | _ => Option.none

def psEraseRuntimeStructureFields

-- Accepted structure fields are exactly the runtime field telescope. Recover
-- direct-recursive flags from the actual constructor, without changing record
-- names, source slots or generic field types.
def psErasureStructureRecursorFields
    (numParams : Nat) (recursiveFields : List Nat)
    (fields : List PsRuntimeStructureField) (index : Nat) :
    Except PsErasureError (List PsRuntimeConstructorField) :=
  match fields with
  | List.nil => Except.ok List.nil
  | List.cons field rest =>
      if psErasureNatNotEqual field.projectionIndex index then
        Except.error PsErasureError.binderMismatch
      else if psErasureNatNotEqual field.sourceIndex (Nat.add numParams index) then
        Except.error PsErasureError.binderMismatch
      else
        match psErasureStructureRecursorFields numParams recursiveFields rest (Nat.succ index) with
        | Except.error error => Except.error error
        | Except.ok tail =>
            Except.ok (List.cons
              (PsRuntimeConstructorField.mk field.sourceIndex field.name field.type
                (psErasureNatInList recursiveFields index))
              tail)

def psErasureStructureProjectionBindings
    (owner : String) (typeArguments : List PsVerifiedIrType)
    (bindings : List PsVerifiedIrMatchBinding)
    (major : PsVerifiedIrExpr) (body : PsVerifiedIrExpr) : PsVerifiedIrExpr :=
  match bindings with
  | List.nil => body
  | List.cons binding rest =>
      PsVerifiedIrExpr.letE binding.name binding.type
        (PsVerifiedIrExpr.projection owner typeArguments major binding.field)
        (psErasureStructureProjectionBindings owner typeArguments rest major body)

def psEraseStructureRecursorMinor
    (environment : PsEnvironment) (scope : PsErasureScope)
    (eraseAt : PsErasureScope -> PsExpr -> Except PsErasureError PsVerifiedIrExpr)
    (structureInfo : PsRuntimeStructureInfo) (constructorInfo : PsConstructorInfo)
    (view : PsErasureAppView) :
    Except PsErasureError (Option PsVerifiedIrExpr) :=
  let expectedArity := Nat.add structureInfo.numParams 3;
  if psErasureNatNotEqual (psListLength view.args) expectedArity then
    Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedApplication
  else
    match psListMapExcept (psEraseRuntimeType environment scope)
        (psListTake structureInfo.numParams view.args) with
    | Except.error error => Except.error error
    | Except.ok typeArguments =>
        if psErasureNatNotEqual (psListLength typeArguments)
            (psListLength structureInfo.typeParameters) then
          Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedApplication
        else
          match psErasureStructureRecursorFields structureInfo.numParams
              constructorInfo.recursiveFields structureInfo.fields 0 with
          | Except.error error => Except.error error
          | Except.ok fields =>
              match psErasureExprListAt view.args (Nat.add structureInfo.numParams 1) with
              | Option.none => Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedApplication
              | Option.some minor =>
                  match psErasureExprListAt view.args (Nat.add structureInfo.numParams 2) with
                  | Option.none => Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedApplication
                  | Option.some major =>
                      match eraseAt scope major with
                      | Except.error error => Except.error error
                      | Except.ok scrutinee =>
                          let recursiveParameterIndex : Option Nat :=
                            match scope.currentDefinition with
                            | Option.none => Option.none
                            | Option.some current =>
                                match scrutinee with
                                | PsVerifiedIrExpr.var name =>
                                    psErasureFindStringIndex name current.runtimeParameters 0
                                | _ => Option.none;
                          let majorName :=
                            psErasureLocalName scope "_psStructureMajor" "_psStructureMajor"
                              scope.localContext.nextId;
                          if psErasureLocalNameUsed scope majorName then
                            Except.error PsErasureError.fuelExhausted
                          else
                            let minorScope := psErasureReserveOutputName scope majorName;
                            let convert : (PsVerifiedIrTypeParameter × PsVerifiedIrType) -> (String × PsVerifiedIrType) :=
                              fun (entry : PsVerifiedIrTypeParameter × PsVerifiedIrType) =>
                                match entry with
                                | Prod.mk parameter value => Prod.mk parameter.name value;
                            let substitutions :=
                              psListMap convert (psListZip structureInfo.typeParameters typeArguments);
                            let runtimeConstructor :=
                              PsRuntimeConstructorInfo.mk structureInfo.name
                                (psErasureSafeIdentifier
                                  (psNameLastComponent constructorInfo.name) "constructor")
                                constructorInfo.name constructorInfo.numParams fields;
                            match psEraseMatchMinor environment eraseAt minorScope substitutions
                                recursiveParameterIndex runtimeConstructor minor with
                            | Except.error error => Except.error error
                            | Except.ok lowered =>
                                Except.ok (Option.some
                                  (PsVerifiedIrExpr.letE majorName
                                    (PsVerifiedIrType.named structureInfo.name typeArguments)
                                    scrutinee
                                    (psErasureStructureProjectionBindings
                                      structureInfo.name typeArguments lowered.bindings
                                      (PsVerifiedIrExpr.var majorName) lowered.body)))

-- Recursive structure minors have field binders followed by generated IH
-- binders. Open them once; never expand a recursive Core recursor in its IH.
def psEraseRuntimeStructureRecursorApplication
    (environment : PsEnvironment) (scope : PsErasureScope)
    (eraseAt : PsErasureScope -> PsExpr -> Except PsErasureError PsVerifiedIrExpr)
    (view : PsErasureAppView) :
    Except PsErasureError (Option PsVerifiedIrExpr) :=
  match view.head with
  | PsExpr.constE name _ =>
      match psErasureLookupStructureRecursor scope name with
      | Option.none => Except.ok Option.none
      | Option.some structureInfo =>
          match psEnvironmentFindRecursor environment name with
          | Option.none => Except.error (PsErasureError.unknownConstant name)
          | Option.some recursorInfo =>
              if
                  if psErasureNatNotEqual recursorInfo.numParams structureInfo.numParams then true
                  else if psErasureNatNotEqual recursorInfo.numIndices 0 then true
                  else if psErasureNatNotEqual recursorInfo.numMotives 1 then true
                  else psErasureNatNotEqual recursorInfo.numMinors 1 then
                Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedRuntimeTerm
              else
                match psEnvironmentFindConstructor environment structureInfo.constructorName with
                | Option.none =>
                    Except.error (PsErasureError.unknownConstant structureInfo.constructorName)
                | Option.some constructorInfo =>
                    if psErasureBoolNot (psNameEq constructorInfo.inductiveName structureInfo.coreName) then
                      Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedRuntimeTerm
                    else if psErasureNatNotEqual constructorInfo.numParams structureInfo.numParams then
                      Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedRuntimeTerm
                    else if psErasureNatNotEqual constructorInfo.numFields (psListLength structureInfo.fields) then
                      Except.error PsErasureError.unsupportedRuntimeTerm
                    else
                      psEraseStructureRecursorMinor environment scope eraseAt
                        structureInfo constructorInfo view
  | _ => Except.ok Option.none

structure PsErasureSpecialCompletion where

facts: psPrepareRuntimeStructure delegates full parameter/field preparation to the existing inductive helpers.
Each structure field copies the prepared runtime field name/type and stores sourceIndex = numParams + fieldIndex and projectionIndex = fieldIndex.
psPrepareInductiveParameters accepts only type binders; proof and runtime parameters remain refused.
psPrepareConstructorFields accepts only runtime fields, preserves every accepted field slot and refuses proof/type fields.

Existing algebraic constructor preparation marks a runtime field recursive by membership of its source field index in the actual constructor.recursiveFields. The new record helper uses the same membership equation.

The reviewed producer opens all constructor fields, then IHs in actual constructor.recursiveFields order, and closes IHs before fields. Authored direct-recursive indices are ascending source field indices.
The final producer permits only the whole-definition root to register new direct-child IH mappings; nested bodies retain old mappings but cannot create another current-definition recurrence.
The reviewed final-meta constructor refinement substitutes the reconstructed major throughout the remaining IH/body lambdas after field opening.
Source structural-recursion seeding is limited to a root match on the original explicit major.
The complete original parameter-ID vector supports the fixed/result telescope independence guard used by admitted self calls.

argument.text: Only the Core prepass branch with a nonempty actual constructor.recursiveFields list returns Option.none before field substitution. Its existing nonrecursive branch and the surrounding bounded traversal are otherwise unchanged. The recursive structure recursor therefore reaches expression erasure with the full field-plus-IH minor. No synthetic Core major let consumes the whole-entry root eligibility first.

The Expr lookup recognizes the rec suffix only when its owner has a prepared runtime structure entry. The saturated lowering separately checks the actual environment recursor counts (same parameters, zero indices, one motive and one minor), the actual constructor owner and parameter count, and full numFields equality. Prepared source metadata establishes the unique structure constructor and recursor identity; this argument does not quantify over arbitrary forged caller-supplied scope records.

The field conversion checks projectionIndex = the ascending traversal index and sourceIndex = numParams + that index, retaining names and unsubstituted field types. It derives recursive flags from the actual constructor field index, and then uses the unchanged psOpenMatchMinorFields/psOpenMatchMinorHypotheses order via psEraseMatchMinor. The successful preparation domain has no removed field slots: proof/type fields, proof parameters and runtime parameters remain refused. Declaration proof/type parameter scopes are unchanged.

The first numParams Core operands are erased using the existing runtime type eraser. Their count must match the prepared type-parameter vector. The existing parameter-name/type zip and psSubstituteVerifiedType instantiate field binding types, including nested named layouts and canonical unary function values. The major let has exactly the same owner and argument vector used by the record projections. Full original IR checking still validates every projection and body result.

The actual Core major is erased once. Its original lowered variable is used only to locate an eligible declaration runtime-parameter index. A fresh major name is checked and reserved in byOutput/count before any minor binder is opened; byCore, Core IDs and currentDefinition are unchanged. The result is one typed major let whose initializer is the erased major and whose body uses only its variable. This prevents duplicate evaluation of computed majors. All later field/body local-name allocation sees the reservation.

psEraseMatchMinor first opens all fields with fresh Core IDs and typed IR binding names, then opens actual recursive field IH binders. At an eligible whole-entry root, the unchanged hypothesis helper maps each IH to the current actual flat declaration call with the major slot replaced by that field variable and all other runtime/type arguments preserved. This is the already-reviewed ROOT-PRODUCER/MAJOR-REFINEMENT/IH-RECURRENCE interface, now applied to the record's sole constructor. The new path does not expand or recursively re-erase a Core recursor inside its IH. An unused IH emits no call or eager computation.

The new helper preserves currentDefinition only while the original whole expression establishes its field/IH replacements. Existing eraseAt delegates to the cleared child scope for major and body computations, retaining runtimeExpressions but setting currentDefinition to None. Nested structure matches may consume existing outer mappings; they cannot create new current-definition mappings. A demanded unmapped new IH remains an erased-local refusal. Special-boundary splitting also uses the existing child callback and cannot grant root eligibility below overapplication.

The result wraps the minor body in field projection lets in source field order. They refer only to the one captured major and carry the exact prepared owner/type arguments/field names. For the existing closed immutable record representation each projection is a total silent read of an already constructed field value. It adds no callback/body invocation and cannot precede an abort in the major initializer. No field computation is re-evaluated and no recursive hypothesis is forced by projection binding. Existing source computations retain their minor-body order.

The special-entry catalogue records the original structure recursor boundary at numParams + 3 (parameters, motive, minor, major), with missing-prefix completion disabled as for other recursors. Existing special-boundary code splits overapplication at that boundary, lowers the complete recursor once, derives its actual Core result type and applies every remaining operand using canonical unary returned-value calls. This prevents flattened result-function operands from being mistaken for extra recursor slots.

The two new recursive helpers recurse only on the existing field/binding list tail, with all parameters bound before their matches. Every branch builds one descriptor or projection let and calls the direct smaller list at most once. There is no recursive Core expansion, speculative fuel factory or unbounded adapter construction. Existing expression, type, field and source recursion budgets/refusals remain in force.

The helpers use existing typed binder syntax, typed function callbacks, constructor applications, list matches, Nat arithmetic and Except cases. The only changed recursive state is the ascending field index after the structural list major; it uses the existing direct-child normalization class. No new parser syntax or missing expected-type lambda initializer is introduced. This is static source reasoning, not a claim of a completed native or bootstrap execution.
